children.translated_text: Having bowed with head to <s>Prajāpati</s>, the presiding lord of the <s>yuga</s> (five-year cycle), consisting of five years,
Encompassing days, seasons, and solstices, with [all its] limbs — [I], being pure, [pay homage]. //1//
Having bowed with head to Time (<s>Kāla</s>), and having saluted <s>Sarasvatī</s>,
I shall declare the knowledge of time of the great-souled <s>Lagadha</s>. //2//
I shall declare the entire course of the luminaries, in due order,
Approved by the learned in the world, for the attainment of the purpose of sacrificial times. //3//
Twelve and a half years diminished by one, doubled, is called 'elapsed' (<s>gata</s>);

children.text: ṣaṣṭyā ṣaṣṭyā yutaṃ dvābhyāṃ parvaṇāṃ rāśir ucyate // 4
children.translated_text: Joined with two groups of sixty each — that is called the sum of <s>parvans</s> (juncture-days). //4//

children.text: svar ākramete somārkau yadā sākaṃ savāsavau /
children.translated_text: When <s>Soma</s> (the Moon) and <s>Arka</s> (the Sun) together with <s>Vāsava</s> (<s>Indra</s>, i.e., the <s>nakṣatra</s> <s>Śraviṣṭhā</s>) ascend the sky,

children.text: syāt tadādi yugaṃ māghastapaḥ śuklo 'yanaṃ hy udak // 5
children.translated_text: Then begins the <s>yuga</s> — <s>Māgha</s> month, <s>Tapas</s> [season], bright [fortnight], and the northward course (<s>udagayana</s>). //5//
The Sun and Moon begin [their northward course] at the start of <s>Śraviṣṭhā</s> (<s>Dhaniṣṭhā</s>);
The Sun [turns] southward at the middle of <s>Āśleṣā</s> (the Serpent [<s>nakṣatra</s>]) — always [thus] in <s>Māgha</s> and <s>Śrāvaṇa</s>. //6//
In the northward [course]: increase of heat, a <s>prastha</s> (measure) of water, and decrease of nights;
In the southward [course], the reverse — with a change of six <s>muhūrtas</s> per half-year (<s>ayana</s>). //7//
Doubled, the seventh [day] they call [the start]; the thirteenth from the beginning of the <s>ayana</s>;

children.text: caturthaṃ daśamaṃ ca dviryugmādyaṃ bahule 'py ṛtau // 8
children.translated_text: The fourth and tenth, doubled from the beginning of the even [parvans]; also in the dark [fortnight] of the season. //8//

children.text: vasus tvaṣṭā bhavo 'jaś ca mitraḥ sarpāśvinau jalam /
children.translated_text: <s>Vasu</s>, <s>Tvaṣṭā</s>, <s>Bhava</s>, <s>Aja</s>, <s>Mitra</s>, <s>Sarpa</s>, <s>Aśvinau</s>, <s>Jala</s> (Water),

children.text: dhātā kaś cāyanādyāś cārthapañcamabhas tv ṛtuḥ // 9
children.translated_text: <s>Dhātā</s>, and <s>Ka</s> — these are [the deities] beginning from the <s>ayana</s>; the season [is marked by] the fifth <s>nakṣatra</s> [from the <s>ayana</s>-start]. //9//
The <s>nakṣatra</s>-portions should be made as groups of eight, derived from twelve fortnights (<s>pakṣas</s>);
Multiplied by eleven and diminished — if in the bright [fortnight], half of the lunar [portion]. //10//
In place of the eight <s>nakṣatra</s>-portions, nineteen <s>kalās</s> should be made;
In the diminished position, one should calculate seventy-three, in the measure of the diminished. //11//

children.text: tryaṃśo bhaśeṣo divasāṃśabhāgaś caturdaśaś cāpy anīya bhinnam /
children.translated_text: The remaining third of the <s>nakṣatra</s> [portion] is the day-share portion; the fourteenth — divided separately when brought;

children.text: bhārdhe 'dhike cāpi gate paro 'ṃśo dvāv uttamaikaṃ pnavakairavedyam // 12
children.translated_text: When more than half a <s>nakṣatra</s> has passed, the next portion — two of the best, one should declare by the initial [signs]. //12//

children.text: pakṣāt pañcadaśāc cordhvaṃ tadbhuktam iti nirdiśet /
children.translated_text: Beyond fifteen [days] from the <s>pakṣa</s> (fortnight), that which has elapsed should be indicated;
The portion risen with nine — but with two more than the diminished portion. //13//

children.text: jau drā ghaḥ khe śve 'hī ro ṣā cin mū ṣa ṇyaḥ sū mā dhā ṇaḥ /
children.translated_text: <s>Jau</s>, <s>Drā</s>, <s>Ghaḥ</s>, <s>Khe</s>, <s>Śve</s>, <s>Ahī</s>, <s>Ro</s>, <s>Ṣā</s>, <s>Cin</s>, <s>Mū</s>, <s>Ṣa</s>, <s>Nyaḥ</s>, <s>Sū</s>, <s>Mā</s>, <s>Dhā</s>, <s>Ṇaḥ</s>,

children.text: re mṛ ghrāḥ svā 'po 'jaḥ kṛ ṣyo ha jye ṣṭhā ittṛkṣā liṅgaiḥ // 14
children.translated_text: <s>Re</s>, <s>Mṛ</s>, <s>Ghrāḥ</s>, <s>Svā</s>, <s>Po</s>, <s>Jaḥ</s>, <s>Kṛ</s>, <s>Ṣyo</s>, <s>Ha</s>, <s>Jye</s>, <s>Ṣṭhā</s> — these are the <s>nakṣatra</s> abbreviation-signs. //14//
One should know [the time] as equal to the portions beginning with <s>Jāva</s> [i.e., <s>Śraviṣṭhā</s>] in the first half at every <s>parvan</s>, [and] in the latter [half];

children.text: bhādānaṃ syāt caturdaśyāṃ kāṣṭhānāṃ devinā kalāḥ // 15
children.translated_text: The <s>nakṣatra</s> determination (<s>bhādāna</s>) should be [calculated] on the fourteenth [<s>tithi</s>]; the <s>kalās</s> of the <s>kāṣṭhās</s> by the divine [measure]. //15//

children.text: kalā daśa saviṃśā syāt dve muhūrtasya nāḍike /
children.translated_text: A <s>kalā</s> should be ten plus twenty [= thirty]; two <s>nāḍikās</s> make one <s>muhūrta</s>;

children.text: dyutriṃśat tatkalānāṃ tu ṣaṭchatī tryadhikaṃ bhavet // 16
children.translated_text: Of those <s>kalās</s>, thirty-two — six hundred and three more [= 603] will be [in the day]. //16//

children.text: nāḍike dve muhūrtas tu pañcāśatpalam āḍhakam /
children.translated_text: Two <s>nāḍikās</s> [make] one <s>muhūrta</s>; fifty <s>palas</s> [make] one <s>āḍhaka</s>;

children.text: āḍhakāt kumbhako droṇaḥ kuṭapair vardhate tribhiḥ // 17
children.translated_text: From the <s>āḍhaka</s> [comes] the <s>kumbhaka</s>; the <s>droṇa</s> increases by three <s>kuṭapas</s>. //17//

children.text: sasaptakaṃ bhayuk somaḥ sūryo dyūni trayodaśa /
children.translated_text: The Moon [traverses its <s>nakṣatra</s>-portion] together with seven; the Sun [traverses] thirteen days

children.text: navabhāni ca pañcāhnaḥ kāṣṭhāḥ pañcākṣarāḥ smṛtāḥ // 18
children.translated_text: And nine <s>nakṣatras</s>; five days [equal one] <s>kāṣṭhā</s>; five syllables are remembered [as the unit]. //18//
Starting from <s>Śraviṣṭhā</s>, the rising [<s>nakṣatras</s>] should be indicated as preceding, multiplied by the number;

children.text: staryān māsān ṣaḍabhyastān vidyāc cāndramasān ṛtun // 19
children.translated_text: One should know the stellar months multiplied by six as the lunar seasons. //19//
From the elapsed <s>parvan</s>-portions, one should calculate the doubled <s>tithi</s> (lunar day);
In those <s>maṇḍala</s> (orbital cycle) portions, the Sun has reached the end of the <s>tithi</s>'s <s>nakṣatra</s>. //20//
To those <s>kalās</s> of <s>nakṣatra</s>-determination at the <s>parvan</s>, one should add the <s>tithi</s> multiplied by seven;

children.text: prakṣipet tatsamūhas tu vidyād ādānikīḥ kalāḥ // 21
children.translated_text: That total — one should know as the <s>ādānikī</s> (determinative) <s>kalās</s>. //21//

children.text: yad uttarasyāyanato gataṃ syāc cheṣaṃ tu yad dakṣiṇato 'yanasya /
children.translated_text: What has elapsed from the northward course, and what remains of the southward course —

children.text: tad ekaṣaṣṭyā dviguṇaṃ vibhaktaṃ sadvādaśaṃ syād divasapramāṇam // 22
children.translated_text: That, doubled and divided by sixty-one, plus twelve, would be the measure of the day. //22//

children.text: yad ardhaṃ dinabhāgānāṃ sadā parvaṇi parvaṇi /
children.translated_text: What is half of the day-portions — always at each <s>parvan</s>;

children.text: ṛtuśeṣaṃ tu tad vidyāt saṃkhyāya sahaparvaṇām // 23
children.translated_text: One should know that as the remainder of the season, together with the count of <s>parvans</s>. //23//
Thus the summary of methods [has been given]; one should further calculate for the day;
What has been multiplied by the quantity to be known, one should divide by the quantity of the known. //24//
<s>Agni</s>, <s>Prajāpati</s>, <s>Soma</s>, <s>Rudra</s>, <s>Aditi</s>, <s>Bṛhaspati</s>,

children.text: sarpāś ca pitaraś caiva bhagaś caivāryamāpi ca // 25
children.translated_text: <s>Sarpāḥ</s> (the Serpents), <s>Pitaraḥ</s> (the Fathers), <s>Bhaga</s>, and also <s>Aryaman</s>, //25//

children.text: savitā tvaṣṭātha vāyuś cendrāgnī mitra eva ca /
children.translated_text: <s>Savitā</s>, <s>Tvaṣṭā</s>, then <s>Vāyu</s>, <s>Indrāgnī</s>, <s>Mitra</s> as well,

children.text: indro niṛrtir āpo vai viśvedevās tathaiva ca // 26
children.translated_text: <s>Indra</s>, <s>Nirṛti</s>, <s>Āpaḥ</s> (the Waters), and also the <s>Viśvedevāḥ</s> (All-Gods), //26//

children.text: viṣnur vasavo varuṇo 'ja ekapāt tathaiva ca /
children.translated_text: <s>Viṣṇu</s>, <s>Vasavaḥ</s> (the <s>Vasus</s>), <s>Varuṇa</s>, <s>Aja Ekapāt</s>, and likewise

children.text: ahirbudhnyas tathā pūṣā aśvinau yama eva ca // 27
children.translated_text: <s>Ahirbudhnya</s>, and <s>Pūṣan</s>, <s>Aśvinau</s> (the twin <s>Aśvins</s>), and <s>Yama</s> as well. //27//
These are the deities of the <s>nakṣatras</s>. By these, in sacrificial rites,
The name of the sacrificer (<s>yajamāna</s>), born from the <s>nakṣatra</s>, is remembered by those who know the <s>śāstras</s>. //28//
Thus [the reckoning] of months and years, <s>muhūrtas</s>, risings, and <s>parvans</s>,
Encompassing days, seasons, and solstices, with [all its] limbs — <s>Lagadha</s> has declared [this] exposition. //29//
The course of the moon and the sun, traversed in three [ways], the world and the esteem in the world —
the wise one who knows the <s>Vedas</s> attains the course of the moon and the sun traversed in three [ways]. (30)

children.text: viṣuvaṃ tadguṇaṃ dvābhyāṃ rūpahīnaṃ tu ṣaḍguṇam /
children.translated_text: The equinox (<s>viṣuva</s>), multiplied by that factor, by two; [the result] diminished by one, multiplied by six;

children.text: yal labdhaṃ tāni parvāṇi tathārdhaṃ sā tithir bhavet // 31
children.translated_text: what is obtained are the <s>parvan</s>s (juncture days); half of that is the <s>tithi</s> (lunar day). (31)
Of the five-year cycle (<s>yuga</s>), beginning with the bright [fortnight] of <s>Māgha</s> and ending with the dark [fortnight] of <s>Pauṣa</s>,
they declare [this to be] the knowledge of time (<s>kālajñāna</s>). (32)
On the third, the ninth, the full-moon day, and in the dark [fortnight],

children.text: ṣaṣṭhīṃ ca viṣuvān prokto dvādaśīṃ ca samaṃ bhavet // 33
children.translated_text: on the sixth and the twelfth — the equinox (<s>viṣuvān</s>) is declared, and it becomes equal. (33)

children.text: caturdaśīm upavasathas tathā bhaved yathodito dinam upaiti candramāḥ /
children.translated_text: The fast-day (<s>upavasatha</s>) falls on the fourteenth; and as stated, the moon reaches the [prescribed] day.
On the bright day of <s>Māgha</s>, [the year] is yoked [to begin] when [the moon is] at <s>Śraviṣṭhā</s> (Dhaniṣṭhā) — [this is] the annual [reckoning]. (34)

children.text: yathā śikhā mayūrāṇāṃ nāgānāṃ maṇayo yathā /
children.translated_text: Just as the crest [is the chief ornament] of peacocks, and jewels of serpents,
so <s>Jyotiṣa</s> (astronomy) stands at the head of the <s>Vedāṅga</s> sciences. (35)
